# Kit-72

> Kit-72 (kit-72.com) helps households in the Netherlands, Germany and Spain prepare for 72 hours without power, water or outside help. It is an independent site, not a government service. It publishes kit lists, scenario guides and calculators in Dutch, German and Spanish, and for the Netherlands a set of address-level and municipality-level facts taken from open government data.

Kit-72 sells nothing itself. It is funded by affiliate links to shops, disclosed on every page that carries them. Where a page gives a fact about a place (ground level, flood-risk zone, emergency broadcaster, nearest emergency department), the source and the date it was checked are named on that page. The printable handbook also contains a page of practical tricks that are not official advice; that page says so.

## Netherlands: facts per address and municipality (Dutch)

- [Gratis noodhandboek voor jouw adres](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodhandboek/): free four-page handbook generated for one Dutch address: ground level against NAP, flood-risk zone, the two emergency departments reached fastest by car, a map of the neighbourhood, the regional emergency broadcaster and what to do in the first hour.
- [Hoe hoog ligt mijn huis?](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/hoogte-nap/): instant check of the ground level of an address against NAP (source: Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland), with the lowest and highest municipalities.
- [Overstromingsrisico per adres en gemeente](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/overstromingsrisico/): instant check whether an address lies in a designated flood-risk zone (source: Rijkswaterstaat), what zone types A to D mean, and the picture per municipality and province.
- [Rampenzender per regio](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/rampenzender/): the thirteen regional emergency broadcasters with FM frequencies per transmitter and DAB+ block (source: Denk Vooruit, Rijksoverheid), with a lookup by municipality and one page per broadcaster.
- [Noodplan per gemeente](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodplan/): one page for each of the 342 municipalities: emergency broadcaster, nearest emergency departments (source: RIVM), safety region, water board, share of sample points in a flood-risk zone and range of ground levels. The municipality figures come from a sample of sixteen points near homes and say so.

## Netherlands: sourced explainers (Dutch)

Each of these pages gives the short answer first and ends with a numbered list of the official pages it was checked against, with the date.

- [NL-Alert](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/nl-alert/): when the national test message is sent (first Monday of June and December), how to check a phone, why an alert can be missed.
- [Wat doe je als de sirene gaat?](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/sirene/): the monthly test, the official instruction when the siren sounds outside the test, and the government's decisions on the siren network.
- [Noodplan maken](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodplan-maken/): the eight parts of the government's household emergency plan and the Red Cross additions.
- [Noodpakket checklist](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodpakket-checklist/): the twelve items of the government's emergency kit list, what is deliberately not on it, and the grab bag.
- [Noodpakket met een baby](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodpakket-baby/): formula, suitable bottled water, storing milk without a fridge; says where no official advice exists.
- [Contant geld in huis](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/gidsen/contant-geld/): the advice of 70 euro per adult and 30 per child, who calculated it, denominations, and alternatives when card payments fail.
- [Koken zonder stroom](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/gidsen/koken-zonder-stroom/): why burners and barbecues are for outdoors only, carbon monoxide, how long fridge and freezer stay cold, food that needs no cooking.
- [Wc en hygiëne zonder water](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/gidsen/noodtoilet/): flushing with a bucket, what to do when sewers fail, hand hygiene without running water.
- [Zonnepanelen en thuisbatterij bij stroomuitval](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/gidsen/zonnepanelen-thuisbatterij-stroomuitval/): why solar panels switch off in an outage and what a home battery needs to supply backup power.
- [Extreme kou](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/scenario/extreme-kou/): keeping warm when heating fails, KNMI warning thresholds, hypothermia first aid, frozen pipes.

## Netherlands: guides and tools (Dutch)

- [Noodpakket samenstellen](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodpakket-samenstellen/): what belongs in a 72-hour kit, amounts per household, shopping list.
- [Noodpakket 72 uur](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodpakket-72-uur/): the 72-hour kit explained by category.
- [Kopen of zelf samenstellen](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/noodpakket-kopen/): ready-made kits compared with building your own, with shop prices.
- [Denk Vooruit: het overheidsadvies](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/denk-vooruit/): summary of the Dutch government campaign, with links to the official source.
- [Scenario's](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/scenario/): power outage, flood, heat wave, water outage, evacuation, cyber attack.
- [Gidsen](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/gidsen/): water storage, food storage, first-aid kit, power and communication, AI services during a power outage.
- [Productgidsen](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/producten/): emergency radio, power banks, torches, water storage, emergency food, first-aid box, grab bags.
- [Noodpakket-samensteller](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/tools/noodpakket-samenstellen/): interactive checklist for a household.
- [Watercalculator](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/tools/water-calculator/) and [energiecalculator](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/tools/energie-calculator/): how much water and how much power-bank capacity a household needs.

## Germany (German)

- [So wirst du in Deutschland gewarnt](https://www.kit-72.com/de/warnung/): what the siren signals mean, how the NINA warning app works, the date of the national Warntag, and what still works when power and mobile networks fail (source: BBK).
- [Startseite](https://www.kit-72.com/de/): calculator for a household's 72-hour list.
- [Notfallpaket für 72 Stunden](https://www.kit-72.com/de/notfallpaket-72-stunden/): what belongs in the kit.
- [Kaufen oder selbst packen](https://www.kit-72.com/de/notfallrucksack-kaufen/): ready-made kits compared with building your own.
- [BBK-Notfallvorsorge](https://www.kit-72.com/de/bbk-notfallvorsorge/): summary of the advice of the German federal office for civil protection, with links to the source.
- [Szenarien](https://www.kit-72.com/de/szenarien/), [Ratgeber](https://www.kit-72.com/de/ratgeber/), [Produkte](https://www.kit-72.com/de/produkte/) and [Tools](https://www.kit-72.com/de/tools/).

## Spain (Spanish)

- [ES-Alert](https://www.kit-72.com/es/es-alert/): what Spain's phone alert system is, which phones receive it, why an alert can be missed and what to do when it sounds (source: Dirección General de Protección Civil y Emergencias).
- [Inicio](https://www.kit-72.com/es/): calculator for a household's 72-hour list.
- [Mochila de 72 horas](https://www.kit-72.com/es/kit-72-horas/): what belongs in the kit.
- [Comprar o montar el kit](https://www.kit-72.com/es/comprar-kit-emergencia/): ready-made kits compared with building your own.
- [Escenarios](https://www.kit-72.com/es/escenarios/), [guías](https://www.kit-72.com/es/guias/), [componentes](https://www.kit-72.com/es/componentes/) and [herramientas](https://www.kit-72.com/es/herramientas/).

## About

- [Colofon](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/colofon/): who publishes Kit-72.
- [Redactioneel beleid](https://www.kit-72.com/nl/redactioneel-beleid/): how content is written and checked.
- [Sitemap](https://www.kit-72.com/sitemap-index.xml)

In an emergency the instructions of the emergency services and the authorities come first. Call 112 when life is in danger.
